create_DoorEntity: create a DoorEntity instance with position, width, height parameters and an optional parent wall entity
compute_DoorEntity_extent: compute the bounding box extent of a DoorEntity including min/max and size for x, y, z axes
rotate_DoorEntity: rotate a DoorEntity by a given angle in degrees about the Z-axis using scipy Rotation
translate_DoorEntity: translate a DoorEntity by a 3D vector in XYZ space using torch tensors
sort_DoorEntity: generate lexicographic or random sort keys for a DoorEntity based on its position
